claims.explanation: KF-38789 is annotated as a P-selectin (SELP) inhibitor, but the selective killing pattern is best explained by SELP expression: lines that express SELP (or its ligand PSGL1/P-selectin glycoprotein ligand) are sensitized, while lines lacking SELP are protected. The most sensitive lines are enriched for TP53 and CDKN2A/RB1 pathway mutations, suggesting that loss of cell-cycle/apoptotic checkpoints enhances sensitivity to SELP inhibition, whereas the least affected lines include several with intact or different driver profiles (e.g., EGFR-mutant, mesothelioma, and some BRAF-mutant lines).
